label: Google Merchant Center
terms_note: Merchant Center account with a verified + claimed website (our storefront domain), product data must meet the Product data specification and Shopping policies; API data source required before productInputs; quotas per method (numbers not read — quota pages 404); no fee; Content API for Shopping stopped 2026-08-18 so only the Merchant API is valid.

discovery.auth: oauth2 (OAuth client id/secret with scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/content, or a service account added to the Merchant Center account)
sdks: Google API client libraries (Java, Python, PHP, .NET, Node, Go, Ruby) for the Merchant API

rate_limits: per-method quotas, auto-adjusted for products/accounts; products updatable ≤2×/day; increases via MC support; Content API for Shopping SUNSET 2026-08-18 (errors from 2026-09-01)

auth: 1. Tenant creates / verifies a Merchant Center account and claims the storefront domain.
2. Either: OAuth 2 consent for our Google Cloud OAuth client (scope auth/content) — or the tenant adds our service account e-mail as a Merchant Center user.
3. Create an API-type data source (DataSources sub-API) — only API data sources accept programmatic product inputs.
4. Insert productInputs; read processed products for issues (Products sub-API).

endpoints.purpose: create / update / delete a product input (offerId, contentLanguage, feedLabel, attributes: title, description, link, imageLink, price, availability, gtin, brand, condition, shipping)
endpoints.notes: dataSource query param; partial updates for price / availability

endpoints.purpose: performance + price competitiveness + best sellers (Merchant Center Query Language)

reference.limits: Per-method quotas exist (overview: 'quotas and rate limits apply'); the quota guide pages returned 404 in this pass — read the Merchant Center quota page before sizing the sync. - Shopping ads / free listings policies + Product data specification. - Website claim required; account suspensions for policy violations are common — surface product issues from products.list as tenant cards. - Buy on Google (checkout on Google) has ended — no orders.
mcp_sdk: SDK: Google API client libraries (Java, Python, PHP, .NET, Node, Go, Ruby) for the Merchant API

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: OAuth 2.0 client ID of your Google Cloud project (with the Merchant API enabled and the project registered with the Merchant Center account).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: OAuth client secret of the same client.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token from a one-time consent with scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/content by a user of the Merchant Center account; the runtime mints access tokens at https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token.

config_fields.name: data_source
config_fields.help: API product data source to write to, in the form accounts/<account>/dataSources/<id> (Merchant Center > Data sources, or the Data Sources API); only API data sources can be edited.

config_fields.name: content_language
config_fields.help: Two-letter content language of your products, e.g. en; part of the product input id <language>~<feedLabel>~<offerId>.

config_fields.name: feed_label
config_fields.help: Feed label of your products, e.g. US; part of the product input id.

adapter.terms: Google Merchant API (the Content API for Shopping successor). Product changes take a few minutes to be reflected in processed products.

me.note: accounts.get: {name, accountId, accountName, adultContent, timeZone, languageCode} of the configured Merchant Center account.

update_listing.note: productInputs.patch on accounts/{account}/productInputs/{language}~{feedLabel}~{offerId} (listing_id = your offerId) without an updateMask, so only the attributes sent (title, description) change. `price` is NOT applied: Merchant API prices are amountMicros (price x 1,000,000 as an integer string), which cannot be derived here; `quantity` has no Merchant Center equivalent.

end_listing.note: productInputs.delete removes the product input (offerId = listing_id) from the configured data source; the product stops serving on Google once processed. Not reversible (insert it again to restore).

not_offered.create_listing: productInputs.insert requires the price as Price {amountMicros (int64 string), currencyCode} plus link, imageLink and availability; converting the vocabulary's decimal price into micros needs arithmetic the declarative adapter does not have, and the vocabulary has no product page link.
not_offered.set_inventory: Merchant Center products carry an availability state, not a stock quantity (quantities exist only for local inventory per store code); no call sets a stock count for an online offer.
not_offered.list_orders: The Merchant API has no orders resource (checkout happens on the merchant's own site).
not_offered.mark_shipped: No orders or shipments in the Merchant API.

evidence: host merchantapi.googleapis.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
probe: 3/3 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific

spec https://merchantapi.googleapis.com/$discovery/rest?version=accounts_v1, https://merchantapi.googleapis.com/$discovery/rest?version=products_v1: 3/3 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
scopes content: all listed in the discovery document
